RF-Scope APK build information
==============================

App name: RF-Scope
Package: com.rfscope.app
Version: 0.10.3 (versionCode 16)
Build type: debug (installable; Android Debug certificate)
Min SDK: 29 (Android 10)
Target/compile SDK: 34 (Android 14)
Built at: 2026-11-08 (Asia/Shanghai)

Size: 24945826 bytes

Changes in 0.10.3:
- CALC / VBW now performs AVER4, AVER16, MAX HOLD and MIN HOLD in the app.
- scanraw is kept as raw data, so CALC behavior no longer depends on TinySA firmware support.
- Changing CALC mode or frequency range starts a new calculation window.
- MAX HOLD accumulates the highest level per frequency bin.
- MIN HOLD accumulates the lowest level per frequency bin.
- AVER4 / AVER16 use the selected number of recent sweeps.
- Includes v0.10.2 TONE REF fix, PAUSE, MAX EVER and the v0.10 visual refresh.

Notes:
- Debug certificate; not for Play Store publishing.
